sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Elmore Selectboard members: Trevor Braun, Sharon Fortune, and Glenn Schwartz.
Town of Elmore official Town Directory page (elmorevt.org, current): the LOCALLY ELECTED table lists Glenn Schwartz (Chair, to 2027), Sharon Fortune (2028), and Trevor Braun (2029).
Town of Elmore official Town Directory page (elmorevt.org, current): the LOCALLY ELECTED table lists Bruce Olsson as Moderator, term to 2027.

Town of Elmore official Town Directory page (elmorevt.org, current): the Town Directory lists the Town Clerk under its APPOINTED heading: Sandra Lacasse. The office has moved to appointment in Elmore; the holder is recorded as appointed.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Sandra Lacasse as Town Clerk of Elmore.

Town of Elmore official Town Directory page (elmorevt.org, current): the Town Directory lists the Town Treasurer under its APPOINTED heading: Sharon Draper. The office has moved to appointment in Elmore; the holder is recorded as appointed.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Sharon Draper as Town Treasurer of Elmore.
Town of Elmore official Town Directory page (elmorevt.org, current): the LOCALLY ELECTED table lists three listers: June McKinley (2029), Jamie Kollar (2028), and Carla Blood (2027).

Town of Elmore official Town Directory page (elmorevt.org, current): the LOCALLY ELECTED table lists Jane Nutting as Auditor (2029); its other two auditor entries are stale-dated (Carla Blood 2025, Diane Cote 2024), so only Nutting's seat is filled here.
Town of Elmore official Town Directory page (elmorevt.org, current): the LOCALLY ELECTED table lists Eddie Adams as Constable, term to 2027.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Elmore justices of the peace: Trevor Braun, Diane Cote, Sharon Fortune, Bruce Olsson, and Connie Perlin.

Town of Elmore official Town Directory page (elmorevt.org, current): the Town Directory lists the same five justices of the peace, printing the fuller form Constance Perlin, which governs the name recorded here.
